verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs say connecting GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket deploys on every push with a preview URL for every branch, plus automatic preview environments for testing changes before production. Supporting preview features include preview-scoped environment variables, access protection for preview URLs, and comments on preview environments. Missing for 10: explicit per-pull-request wording (the evidence says per-branch/per-push, so PR coverage is implied rather than stated), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
